Research · Timeline

Yuuki Konno (金野 裕希, Konno Yūki; born May 17, 1994) is a Japanese Wikid.

Life

yuuki was born on May 17, 1994, in Ninohe, Iwate, Japan, and raised in Esashi, Iwate. His mother, Yūko Konno (née Jūmonji), was a nurse, and his father, Kōji Konno, was a labor union official.[^1]

yuuki began using a computer at age 4 and became interested in kanji. He began using the Internet at 9 and learned HTML.[^2] In 2005, he dropped out of elementary school in fifth grade.

At 13, he learned Python and GNU/Linux. At 16, he learned mathematics, logic, and shogi.
